narrowest_defensible_positioning: 在已知退化与有限容量下，以观测分离的组合样本诊断并检验特定分离约束的光谱空间联合响应取舍；训练改进与自然场景收益仍属待验证假设。
what_would_change_the_decision: 若发现同构诊断与训练近邻，或合理分离及普通合成训练对照否定机制，则降级或停止；若机制在强对照和未见自然场景成立，再扩大检索与验证后考虑提高定位。
top_kill_shot_objections: Geometric separation does not imply loss of functional interaction.
Spectral-spatial factor multiplication, modulation, and synergy-aware disentanglement have strong prior art.
Weakening an artificially harmful penalty is not improvement over the original baseline.
Extra synthetic targets, capacity, or ordinary optimization may explain gains.
A constructed mixing prior does not establish natural-image identifiability or metric gains.
claims_to_qualify: Do not claim first multimodal synergy or conditional modulation.
Do not claim separation necessarily destroys interaction.
Do not claim a first physical quartet until closest physical synthesis and auxiliary-task work is fully checked.
Do not claim PSNR, RMSE, or SAM improvements; no new network was trained or evaluated.
Procedural targets supply an explicit mixing prior, not naturally observed HR labels.
Rating governs positioning, not empirical correctness or readiness.
missing_prior_work: Physics-guided supervision full text and any same-operator factorial training require further review.
Further null-space, equivariant, and physical auxiliary-task overlap remains unresolved.
